'''Nordoxicon''' was a company that manufactured a variety of components for [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as [[Anti-concussion field generator/Legends|anti-concussion field generators]] and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]].

Its [[Micro Instrument division]] made weapon sights and targeting systems.<ref name="SWS" />
